purpose: Ten business questions with an independent pandas answer, to compare by hand with InsightIQ. InsightIQ was NOT run on them. This is a record on one file, not a measure of accuracy.

dataset.source: first and only sheet of 'Online Retail 2.xlsx' converted to CSV without changes (541,909 data rows, 8 columns: InvoiceNo, StockCode, Description, Quantity, InvoiceDate, UnitPrice, CustomerID, Country)
dataset.note_on_checksum: The CSV loaded into the real app on 2026-11-23 was converted again (InvoiceNo, StockCode, CustomerID kept as text) and has a different checksum; row count (541,909), columns and all ten expected values are unchanged.

conventions.revenue: Quantity x UnitPrice per row (the file has no revenue column)
conventions.sales_lines: sales lines = InvoiceNo does not start with 'C' AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0
conventions.missing_CustomerID: kept for revenue and unit counts; never counted as a customer
conventions.rounding: expected money values are rounded to 2 decimals for reading; compare against unrounded values to the cent
conventions.pandas_loading: df = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={'InvoiceNo': str, 'StockCode': str, 'CustomerID': str}, parse_dates=['InvoiceDate'])
conventions.sales_view_in_pandas: s = df[~df['InvoiceNo'].str.startswith('C') & (df['Quantity'] > 0) & (df['UnitPrice'] > 0)]   # used by questions 5 to 10

questions.question: How many rows (invoice lines) are in the file?
questions.how_calculated: Count of all rows, nothing excluded.

questions.question: How many different invoices are there?
questions.how_calculated: Distinct InvoiceNo over all rows (cancellation invoices, which start with C, are counted as invoices).

questions.question: How many lines are cancellations?
questions.how_calculated: Rows whose InvoiceNo starts with the letter C. Those rows have a negative Quantity.
questions.note: Rows with a negative Quantity but no C (stock adjustments) are NOT cancellations here: 1336 such rows.

questions.question: What is the net revenue, counting cancellations as credits?
questions.how_calculated: revenue = Quantity x UnitPrice on every row, then summed. Cancellation rows have negative Quantity, so they subtract. Missing CustomerID rows are included (revenue does not need a customer).
questions.note: Rows with a non-positive UnitPrice are included here: 2517 rows with UnitPrice <= 0.

questions.question: What is the sales revenue, leaving out cancellations and non-sale rows?
questions.how_calculated: revenue = Quantity x UnitPrice, summed over sales lines = InvoiceNo does not start with 'C' AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0. Missing CustomerID rows are included.
questions.note: 11805 lines are left out of the sales view.

questions.question: Which 5 countries have the most sales revenue?
questions.how_calculated: Sales revenue per Country (sales lines = InvoiceNo does not start with 'C' AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0), highest first.

questions.question: Which 5 products sold the most units?
questions.how_calculated: Total Quantity per Description over sales lines = InvoiceNo does not start with 'C' AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0. Grouped by Description text exactly as written; blank descriptions are not a product.
questions.note: If two products tie for 5th place the order between them is not defined.

questions.question: How many different customers bought something, and how many lines have no customer?
questions.how_calculated: Distinct CustomerID over sales lines = InvoiceNo does not start with 'C' AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0 rows that HAVE a CustomerID (a blank customer is not a customer). The second number counts sales lines with a blank CustomerID.

questions.question: Which month had the highest sales revenue?
questions.how_calculated: Sales revenue (sales lines = InvoiceNo does not start with 'C' AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0) grouped by the calendar month of InvoiceDate; the month with the largest total.
questions.note: Dates are read as written in the file; no time-zone shift.

questions.question: What is the average value of an order?
questions.how_calculated: Sales revenue (sales lines = InvoiceNo does not start with 'C' AND Quantity > 0 AND UnitPrice > 0) divided by the number of distinct InvoiceNo among those sales lines.
questions.note: Distinct invoices in the sales view: 19960.

ui_comparison_2026_11_23: All ten answers matched in the app; see docs/demo/ONLINE_RETAIL_DEMO_GUIDE.md section 5. Questions 2 to 10 were asked with the calculation rule written into the question. Q7 and Q9 were answered on a retry after a provider rate-limit error.
